AC-ra-29 is proven in the API test by comparing the raw diagnosis rows (result, stage, rulesVersion, completedAt, updatedAt), GET /api/diagnoses/:id and GET /api/diagnoses/:id/comparison before and after tracking edits and after a new conclusion. The PDF of a previous diagnosis is not compared here: the 'Andamento das ações' page and the report documents belong to the phase-3-backend-action-reports unit.

Archived diagnoses are left out of the company 'closed' list (the timeline treats them as put away); GET /api/diagnoses/:id/actions of an archived diagnosis still answers with isCurrent=false and PATCH answers 409 plan_closed. Overdue is only true for the current plan (RULE-ra-06).

messages.text: IF-005 is live. src/api/actionsApi.ts exports getCompanyActions(companyId), getDiagnosisActions(diagnosisId) and updateAction(diagnosisId, actionKey, patch) plus the types ActionProgress, ActionPlan, CompanyActions, DiagnosisActions, ActionPatch and InheritedFrom. ActionProgress = { diagnosisId, actionKey, status, dueDate (YYYY-MM-DD|null), ownerRole|null, note|null, overdue, inheritedFrom: { diagnosisId, completedAt }|null, updatedAt }. Company: { current: { diagnosisId, completedAt, actions[] }|null, closed: [{ diagnosisId, completedAt, actions[] }] } (closed newest first, archived diagnoses not listed). Diagnosis: { isCurrent, actions[] } with actions in the order of result.plan. PATCH is partial and null clears dueDate/ownerRole/note; a blank note is stored as null; the server limit is 500 characters counted as typed. Errors: 400 validation_failed (fields.status|dueDate|ownerRole|note|_root), 404 diagnosis_not_found|company_not_found|action_not_found, 409 plan_closed (plan replaced or diagnosis archived: show the action closed, without controls) and 409 diagnosis_not_completed (draft). updatedAt falls back to the diagnosis completedAt while a version 1 diagnosis has no row. React key = diagnosisId:actionKey.

DiagnosisRepository.completeDraft changed: build now receives (draft, { latestCompleted: { record, progress } | null }) and returns { values: CompletionValues, actionProgress: InheritedActionProgress[] }; the repository creates the tracking rows with createMany in the same transaction. I found no other caller in server/, tests/ or scripts/. New DiagnosisRepository.listCompletedRecords(companyId) returns the completed, non-archived diagnoses with their stored result, newest first (null when the company does not exist); the portfolio/report units can reuse it.

Not run by this unit (outside its Done when): pnpm build, node scripts/smoke-migrate.mjs, Playwright (tests/e2e/actions.spec.ts, result.spec.ts, history.spec.ts) and the walkthrough in the Play dev-link. AC-ra-32's 'diário' cascade needs the Phase 4 diary table; AC-ra-29's PDF comparison needs the reports unit's 'Andamento das ações' page.
